verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an official Codex CLI within the ChatGPT product family. It lets you inspect code, make changes, and run commands from the terminal, with `--cd`/`-C`, `--search`, `/fast` and `/memories` controls, and the llms.txt probe confirms it. There is also an official Codex Security CLI run via `npx @openai/codex-security`. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI, install/authentication documentation, and a visual preview/annotation interface (docs say the CLI lacks one).
